verdict.rationale: Plausible documents its own API keys that are scoped to a single team, which limits which sites they can query (plausible-docs-17). The Stats API they access is read-only (plausible-docs-4), so an agent key is inherently limited to viewing stats. That is real, documented least-privilege, but scoping stops at the team level, and there is no evidence of finer-grained permission choices when issuing a key. missing for 10: per-site or per-endpoint key scoping, selectable permission scopes at key creation, key expiry/rotation controls, independent corroboration.
